title: Fugaro credentials service bundle
description: The document in the credentials service's ONE Secret Manager container (Q6, ruled 2026-10-19): a YAML map of credential names to values, read by the service alone (docs/credentials-service/implementation-plan.md, Task C1.11). The keys are exactly the model credentials the platform defines, and the loader refuses a key outside them rather than ignoring it. Written by `fugaro creds set NAME` (C1.25) and by nothing else: no workflow may declare the container's name and `fugaro secrets set` refuses it. A value is never logged, echoed in an error or sent anywhere but to the provider the credential belongs to.
$comment: The bounds mirror internal/credsvc/bundle.go's constants, which are the loader's own rules: maxProperties is MaxBundleCredentials (the wire contract's maxTriedEntries, C1.10), maxLength is MaxBundleValueBytes, and the key pattern is internal/config's two credential families as internal/credsvc's CredentialKey reads them (config.AnthropicSecret, config.ClaudeOAuthToken, and config.ClaudeAccountSecret of a name matching config.ClaudeAccountNameRE). TestBundleSchemaMatchesTheLoader in internal/credsvc holds the two together, so neither the schema nor the loader can be widened alone.
